Changes in v0.12.0:

- Projects: the project picker under the message box now works in an open conversation too. Pick a project to move the conversation onto it, or "No project" to take it off.
- Projects: when Ari moves a conversation onto a project (or off one), the picker shows the change straight away.
- Conversations: the × on a conversation in the sidebar now hides it instead of deleting it. Closing a conversation, or deleting a saved one forever, is in its right-click menu.
- Brain: Engram no longer follows the chat's thinking dial. Its saves always think at medium and its brain-curation plans at low, so a high setting can't send it wandering before it writes anything.
- Brain: Engram's curation plans are told how to think: name the few biggest problems, the groups that fix them and any certain merge, then write the plan.
- Brain page: opens framed on the whole brain at any size. A few far-off loose notes no longer push the camera out.
- Brain page: zooming is gentler and glides smoothly, so a trackpad no longer flies in and out.
- Brain page: the notes and clusters listed under "Inside" can be clicked. A note opens it; a cluster flies into it.
